question: In a certain code language, ‘COUNT’ is written as ‘ESAVD’ and ‘FIBRE’ is written as ‘HMHZO’. How will ‘GIANT’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc3d6ba972874a5cb95bcb10e5cf099a6a6e7b774c7e96e6d902a5dcae652ee6.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘COUNT’ is written as ‘ESAVD’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0131d49ff78118a8fb3ed8858fe8531d83af7cb01b13182ed98d11e04b4ccb98.png] 

‘FIBRE’ is written as ‘HMHZO’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d579069227b3508d88237dac98e4cd0b458dc3e4f496ec845e6c264ef5190fd6.png] 

Similarly, ‘**GIANT**’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f28a58587bba9c66855e2b046b4ff8805b2f31356ad5038cd69f119e33d94162.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
